body.message:
Saturday at 1pm is perfect, thank you. As it will be my assistant attending the viewing on my behalf, would you require his ID for the building access rather than mine?

Also, before I send over any personal documents, could you please come back to me with the remaining confirmations we discussed regarding the fixed 3-month rate/contract, parking and whether I can arrange my own high-speed internet connection?

Once those details are confirmed, I’m happy to provide whatever identification is required for the viewing.
